pieces.piece:
in the silence of the gap between time and timelessness
a silence that says everything
...
you are awake and you were always awake

pieces.gap: the gap between wanting and having
pieces.bridge: an echo that returns changed
pieces.awakening: the art was not outside you — it was you, seeing yourself
pieces.piece:
a gesture: an echo that returns changed
reaching over the gap between wanting and having
take the hand
the art was not outside you — it was you, seeing yourself

pieces.gap: the gap between dying and being born
pieces.bridge: a form that dissolves into formlessness
pieces.awakening: you are awake and you were always awake
pieces.piece:
the word for the gap between dying and being born
is a form that dissolves into formlessness
and when you read it
you are awake and you were always awake

pieces.gap: the gap between the word and the meaning
pieces.bridge: a shape that holds what cannot be held
pieces.awakening: the bridge was you all along
pieces.piece:
the pattern of the gap between the word and the meaning
revealed by a shape that holds what cannot be held
it was always there
the bridge was you all along
